title: thymus pulegioides var. danubialis
intro: Thymus pulegioides var. danubialis, commonly known as Danube thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus pulegioides plant, a type of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include digestive relief, reduction of inflammation, and antimicrobial effects, providing health benefits such as soothing digestive issues and alleviating cold and flu symptoms. The therapeutic actions of Danube thyme include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and contribute to its popularity in herbal medicine.
